description: Check whether a document has finished processing. Returns a concise status (pending / processing / completed / failed / cancelled) plus the current processing phase. Poll this after triggering processing — every 10-15 seconds, no faster, because the API is rate limited. Processing typically takes 30 seconds to 5 minutes depending on document size.

document_id.description: Document ID (UUID). Get IDs from list_documents.

name: get_processing_status
title: Get Processing Status
